```{r}
#| label: setup

library(dplyr)
library(arrow)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tidylog)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pointblank)

data_dir <- here::here("inputs/")
mar_dir <- paste0(data_dir, "/2026-03-11/")
aug_dir <- paste0(data_dir, "/2026-08-07/")

```

```{r}
col_types_mar <- c(
  "date", # Detainer Prepare Date

  "text", # MSC Charge
  "numeric", # MSC Sentence Days
  "numeric", # MSC Sentence Months
  "numeric", # MSC Sentence Years

  "date", # MSC Charge Date
  "date", # MSC Conviction Date
  "text", # Aggravated Felon Yes No

  "text", # Other Removal Reason

  "date", # Order to Show Cause Served Date

  "text", # Detainer Lift Reason Code

  "text" # Anonymized Identifier

detainers_df_aug <-
  list.files(
    aug_dir,
    pattern = "^[^~].*DPR",
    full.names = TRUE
  ) |>
  set_names(basename) |>
  map_dfr(
    function(f) {
      readxl::excel_sheets(f) |>
        set_names() |>
        map_dfr(
          function(s) {
            readxl::read_excel(
              path = f,
              sheet = s,
              col_types = col_types_aug,
              skip = 6
            )
          },
          .id = "sheet_original"
        )
    },
    .id = "file_original"
  )

# FY23 and FY24 files lack the Birth Date column
col_types_fy2324 <- col_types_mar[-16]

detainers_df_mar <-
  list.files(
    mar_dir,
    pattern = "^[^~].*Detainers",
    full.names = TRUE
  ) |>
  set_names(basename) |>
  map_dfr(
    function(f) {
      # FY23/FY24 files lack Birth Date column
      n_cols <- ncol(readxl::read_excel(f, n_max = 0, skip = 6))
      ct <- if (n_cols == length(col_types_mar)) {
        col_types_mar
      } else {
        col_types_fy2324
      }
      readxl::excel_sheets(f) |>
        set_names() |>
        map_dfr(
          function(s) {
            readxl::read_excel(
              path = f,
              sheet = s,
              col_types = ct,
              skip = 6
            )
          },
          .id = "sheet_original"
        )
    },
    .id = "file_original"
  )


```


## Naive cleaning
```{r}


detainers_df_mar <- detainers_df_mar |> 
    janitor::clean_names()

detainers_df_aug <- detainers_df_aug |> 
    janitor::clean_names()

```


## Weekly counts

```{r}

dat_mar <- detainers_df_mar |> 
    mutate(week = floor_date(detainer_prepare_date, unit="weeks")) |> 
    count(week) |> 
    mutate(source = "2026-03 release")

dat_aug <- detainers_df_aug |> 
    mutate(week = floor_date(detainer_prepared_date, unit="weeks")) |> 
    count(week) |> 
    mutate(source = "2026-08 release")

dat <- rbind(dat_mar, dat_aug)

p1 <- dat |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = week, y = n, color = source, group = source)) +
    geom_line() + theme_minimal()

p1

```
